{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
filtered_penguins = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = filtered_penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the exact means to ensure they are captured
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract and print the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'Highest mean species: {highest_mean_species}')"}
